design_archetype: Organic & Tactical Sanctuary (Warm Slate + Soft Sage + Amber Spark)

navigation.type: Header with Workspace Switcher + Google Login User Menu

spaces.label: Advance Planning
spaces.description: Weekly day templates assigned to weekdays, block creation, splits, buffers, and % task allocation.

spaces.label: Now & Next View
spaces.description: Quick view showing ONLY the active block or upcoming block, never the full day, with live calculated minutes.

spaces.label: Focus Execution Mode
spaces.description: Full-screen distraction-free sanctuary displaying single active task, ring timer, sub-checklist, and calm visuals.

template_editor.block_card: bg-[#15181E] border border-[#2A2E39] rounded-2xl p-6 transition-all hover:border-slate-600
features: Time blocks splittable into two sub-blocks with mandatory transition buffer slider
3 task types with visual badges (% recurring share, 1-off checkmark, fixed-time slot)
Protected minimum duration toggle with alert state if block time is exhausted
Must-complete-today quota checkbox with visual impact preview on later blocks
Free-text task notes modal/popover drawer with Markdown/bullet support

now_next_view.rule: CRITICAL: NEVER show the whole day here. Focus strictly on current block + immediate next block.
elements: Live block progress indicator with real-time dynamic minute recalculation badge
Adaptive task queue displaying calculated exact duration in real-time
Quick start focus trigger button leading into Execution Mode

execution_mode.vibe: Ultra-calm, zero clutter, dark slate backdrop with soft breathing ambient lighting
elements: Large high-contrast ring timer with JetBrains Mono live countdown
Current active task title in bold Outfit font
Conscious delay logger (+5 min / +10 min) with threshold warning prompt

decision_prompts.modal_style: High-priority alert dialog with glassmorphism backdrop overlay (bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md)
triggers: Delay exceeds configured threshold (e.g., >15 mins off schedule)
Minimum protected task duration cannot fit into remaining block time

undo_toast.style: Floating bottom bar with active 5-second countdown progress ring and Instant Undo button
undo_toast.use_case: Sensitive automatic dynamic time redistributions, task completions pulling time forward

random_visual_rewards.mechanism: Random probability (~35%) on checking sub-tasks or completing tasks
random_visual_rewards.visual: Elegant subtle canvas confetti or golden aura burst overlay rather than garish loud popups

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts 'Outfit', 'Plus Jakarta Sans', and 'JetBrains Mono' in index.html or top level CSS.
Implement the 3 distinct spaces (Advance Planning, Now/Next Block View, Focus Execution Mode) with clean top tab bar navigation.
CRITICAL: Ensure ALL interactive elements, buttons, inputs, modals, tabs, and status cards have explicit 'data-testid' attributes.
Use Lucide-React icons for crisp UI representations (Calendar, Clock, Split, Shield, CheckCircle2, Zap, AlertTriangle, RotateCcw, Lock, FileText).
Use Sonner for notifications and implement the custom floating 5-second Undo bar for automatic time redistribution.
Maintain state persistence in localStorage / API for day templates, current tasks, notes, settings, and delay logs.
Make Execution Mode feel genuinely serene: dark monochrome canvas, warm sage ring countdown timer, sub-task list, and optional calm nature background toggle.
Include Google Login landing state / mock auth user switcher for personal single-user account flow.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic white backgrounds or default unstyled components.
Every container with a border MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.
Avoid Inter for headings; use Outfit or uppercase tracking-widest style for micro-labels.
Do not use transparent dropdown or popover backgrounds - always use solid/glass surface with backdrop-blur-md and clear border.
Ensure high text contrast for WCAG readability across dark slate backgrounds.
Always test grid layout responsiveness on mobile (grid-cols-1) up to desktop (grid-cols-12).
